title: Persistent state is not the event
description: Separate what remains resident from what is communicated or selected now. AdaptiveObserverCache now makes the distinction literal at two timescales: a slow evidence-derived observer state persists outside the prompt while one fast Qwen KV cache grows token by token.

title: Structure becomes an operator
description: Geometry/material/connectivity compiles into future signal flow.

title: Bounded observation can be active
description: Choose where/how to measure instead of demanding global access.

title: Intervene to reveal what passive reading hides
description: Known writes, stimulation or rollback expose response structure and causal responsibility.

title: Experience changes future response geometry
description: The recurring object is not only state but how the next perturbation will be transformed.

title: A global scalar can localize scarce action
description: Designed interventions plus one consequence signal can beat blind search when faults/actions are sparse.

title: State is not current relevance
description: Maintain richer state and apply current relevance nearer publication/readout.

title: Keep belief separate from evidence
description: Remember what was observed, inferred or externally supported.

title: Kills are part of the lineage
description: Strong descendants often exist because an attractive predecessor claim failed under a sharper control.

title: Keep what disappears: the transient can be conserved by telescoping residues
description: Sigh supplies the iterative trajectory. Sihti and SighImageFactorization both save departures r_k=x_k-x_{k+1}, so the initial state is recovered by summing residues plus the terminal core even when the purifier changes. This makes residue time an exact bookkeeping coordinate without implying that the coordinate transform itself discovers objects.

title: The operator decides what persistence means
description: A fixed Fourier operator sorts by spectral lifetime; an image-built affinity operator sorts by grouping/cohesion; a history-written operator can preserve relations learned from common fate. The recurring object is the operator that defines which distinctions die quickly, survive, or become visible to later dynamics.

title: Memory cannot manufacture information that was never observable
description: SighImageSuper shows that a physically present distinction may be invisible to one probe. SighImageFactorization Gate 17 gives the sharper causal form: identical observed prefixes force identical deterministic causal state and chance future classification. Gate 18 only escapes by adding a genuinely informative pre-relapse observable.

title: Separate the reusable measurement from the world-specific meaning attached to it
description: Sihti uses the same residue instrument under different purifiers and measures where objects go rather than treating one coordinate system as meaning itself. SighImageFactorization Gate 19 makes the separation explicit: RGB motion surprise can transfer across covariate shift while the surprise-to-relapse mapping weakens, disappears or reverses with the world contingency.

title: The observer is part of the state
description: Across the wall, observation repeatedly stops being a fixed readout. MoireBrain changes visible structure with observer scale; GeometricNeuronV24 and ReadWrite formalize bounded lenses and intervention; SighImageSuper makes recoverability query-dependent; PredictiveHKT shows a moving representation can impersonate world drift; SplatWorld4 and WhatToLookAt choose where to measure; AuditedEpistemicCache records representation/provenance validity; OperatorTime makes reader state part of the effective operator; AInstein makes provenance load-bearing. AdaptiveObserverCache now makes the loop executable in a frozen Qwen: a persistent external observer changes current query geometry over byte-stable historical K/V while one live cache continues to grow. The first live second turn preserved the old source addresses and cache integrity as evidence changed the observer, although the generated answer did not yet cross the language boundary.

title: A reusable belief needs a receipt for how it was measured
description: A cached belief cannot be identified only by value and age. Query/intervention, viewpoint, provenance, representation generation and measurement implementation can determine whether it still means the same thing. AdaptiveObserverCache now operationalizes both halves: external sensor/tool/independent-model/user-verification receipts may update slow trust, while self/model-prediction receipts are logged but cannot anchor it; the resulting state then changes how unchanged historical K/V is read.
